Obsidian Weld.name: Obsidian Weld
Obsidian Weld.description: The user melts and quenches stone in a single heartbeat, turning broken concrete, brick and bedrock along a street into seamless volcanic glass. In one turn they seal a collapsing tunnel, draw all lingering heat out of a burning building's masonry so rescuers can enter, and cast poured-stone cuffs onto every enemy on the street for heavy fire damage; held back, the cuffs quench cool in mid-flow and lock them harmlessly in place. Pulling that heat through their hands leaves the user unable to use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
